description: A melody generator that learns which note follows which from what you play it, then walks that map to make new melodies of the same shape

params.text: Switches learning on and off; while it is on, a gate at the gate input adds the note at the cv input to the map
Removes the note the module is on from the map, with every link into it
Sets how closely the next note follows what was taught: at -1 the most frequent follower every time, at 0 the taught proportions, and towards +1 the rarer followers and jumps elsewhere in the map

inputs.text: A gate here switches learning on and off, adding to whatever the record button is set to
A gate here removes the note the module is on from the map, with every link into it
Adds to the randomness knob, a tenth of a unit per volt over its travel from -1 to 1
The note to learn or to jump to, as a 1V/octave pitch
A gate marks a note at the cv input: while learning it is added to the map, and otherwise the module jumps to the learned note nearest it
A rising edge moves on to a next note, drawn from the notes that were played after the current one

outputs.text: The note the module is on, as a 1V/octave pitch
A gate that is high whenever the trigger input is high, and drops for the single sample a trigger arrives on so that each new note reads as a new gate

notes: the map starts empty, so the module puts out nothing until you switch learning on and play notes into the cv and gate inputs.
the grid above the knob shows every note learned so far with the current one picked out; it cannot be edited.
the learned map is saved with the patch.
menu: dehumanize — draws the panel plain instead of as a figure
face wiggle — lets the drawn face move as the randomness setting changes
never change clothes — keeps the drawn figure's clothing fixed

inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

inputs.5: high above 0.1V · stepped · one channel only
